text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! The great escape of the captive 
Umamusume is complete!
choice_data_list: It's not like I took all of them, though.
It's not like I took all of them, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about them. Looks like they've 
made that transparent box their safe haven 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"We gotta find a haven... an Eden, for the 
guy who managed to pull off a successful 
escape."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For now, how about we make McQueen's or 
Jordan's room a 'Provisional Eden'?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's go right 
now! Charge into the paradise known as 
"Provisional Eden"!!
